page.layout: One column of verse, set left, with a title line above it. Two short titles "Aliud Epitaphium Alexandri:" and "Aliud in eundem:" stand apart within the verse. Catchword at lower right. No marginal notes; faint mirrored text from the other side on the right margin is show-through and omitted.

main_text.p: Titulum quem Alexandri uides, haud illius Magni est: sed huius, qui modo Libidinosa sanguinis captus siti, Tot ciuitates inclytas, Tot regna uertit, totq; duces letho dedit, Natos ut impleat suos: Orbem rapinis, ferro & igne funditus Vastauit, hausit, eruit: Humana iura, nec minus caelestia, Ipsosq; sustulit deos: Vt scilicet liceret (heu scelus) patri Nata sinum permingere: Nec execrandis abstinere nuptiis, Timore sublato semel. Et tamen in urbe Romuli uel undecim Praefidet hic annis Pontifex. Nunc, Nerones uel Caligulas nomina, Turpeis uel Heliogabalos. Hoc sat[?] uiator, reliqua non finit pudor: Tu suspicare, & ambula.
main_text.head: Aliud Epitaphium Alexan-dri:
main_text.p: Hic iacet Hispanus, famae contemptor honestae: Vis breuium lapis hic contegit omne scelus.
main_text.head: Aliud in eundem:
main_text.p: Nomen Alexandri ne te fortasse moretur,

page.notes: Right margin carries faint show-through from the reverse page; omitted. Word "sat" read from a long-s form "fat" and marked [?]. Running head "VII" partly faded but read as VII. Scan edges are dark and the lower left is smudged; no further damage affects the words.
